codeReview.summary: The implementation fully covers the feature requirements. ProxySettings interface was added with proxies array, enabled boolean, rotationMode enum, and domainAssignments. The Proxy tab includes enable/disable toggle, rotation mode selector (Manual/Automatic/Per-Domain), and proxy list placeholder. Settings sync to backend via invoke() calls for proxy pool management.

issues.description: The Proxy tab was moved from before History tab to after History tab. This changes the tab order. While this is not a bug, it's worth noting the UI change from the original implementation which had Proxy between Validation and History.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The use-settings.ts hook now includes comprehensive proxy management functions (addProxy, updateProxy, deleteProxy, clearProxies, updateProxyPoolConfig, assignDomainProxy, unassignDomainProxy) in addition to the generic updateSettings. This pattern of domain-specific management functions could be documented as the preferred approach for complex settings that need backend sync.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/hooks/use-settings.ts lines 156-228 - proxy management functions follow a pattern of optimistic local state update + backend invoke + error handling with rollback

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker discovered that proxy settings are stored separately from other settings in the backend. The BackendSettings interface does not include proxy fields, and proxy pool is loaded/saved via separate Tauri commands (get_proxy_pool, update_proxy_pool_config, etc.) rather than through the generic save_settings command.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/hooks/use-settings.ts - BackendSettings interface (lines 37-44) excludes proxy fields; separate BackendProxyPool interface (lines 46-51) handles proxy state; useSettings loads both in parallel via separate invoke calls

summary: PASS - The proxy-settings-frontend feature is well implemented. All expected behaviors are present: ProxySettings interface with required fields, Proxy tab in settings navigation, functional enable/disable toggle that persists, rotation mode dropdown with all three modes (Manual, Automatic, Per-Domain), and backend synchronization via Tauri invoke commands. The implementation includes 9 new tests covering tab navigation, toggle functionality, rotation mode selection, and UI state changes. Code quality is good with proper TypeScript types, error handling with toast notifications, and optimistic UI updates with rollback on error. One minor non-blocking observation: the tab order changed (Proxy moved after History). Two shared state observations documented: the pattern of domain-specific management functions in hooks, and the separation of proxy settings from general settings in backend sync.
